#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Resolve Makefile conflicts by merging both sides' additions."""
import re

with open('Makefile', 'r') as f:
    content = f.read()

# Conflict 1: .PHONY line
# Upstream: has test-emit-design-plan-preview and test-check-plan-size but NOT test-parse-plan-commands and test-validate-plan-commands
# Feature: has test-parse-plan-commands and test-validate-plan-commands but NOT the upstream additions
# Resolution: take feature branch (has parse/validate) AND add the upstream's test-emit-design-plan-preview and test-check-plan-size

# Find first conflict (lines 4-8)
conflict1_pattern = r'<<<<<<< HEAD\n(.*?)\n=======\n(.*?)\n>>>>>>> .*?\n'
matches = list(re.finditer(conflict1_pattern, content, re.DOTALL))
print(f"Found {len(matches)} conflicts")

# Conflict 1: .PHONY line
# The feature branch line has test-parse-plan-commands and test-validate-plan-commands
# The upstream has test-emit-design-plan-preview and test-check-plan-size
# Merge: take feature branch AND add the two from upstream after test-emit-plan
m1 = matches[0]
upstream_phony = m1.group(1).strip()
feature_phony = m1.group(2).strip()

# Insert test-emit-design-plan-preview and test-check-plan-size into feature branch line after test-emit-plan
merged_phony = feature_phony.replace(
    'test-emit-plan test-parse-plan-commands',
    'test-emit-plan test-emit-design-plan-preview test-check-plan-size test-parse-plan-commands'
)
print(f"PHONY merged: ...{merged_phony[200:400]}...")
content = content[:m1.start()] + merged_phony + '\n' + content[m1.end():]

# Re-find conflicts
matches = list(re.finditer(conflict1_pattern, content, re.DOTALL))
print(f"After conflict1 resolution: {len(matches)} remaining conflicts")

# Conflict 2: shard 12 line
m2 = matches[0]
upstream_shard12 = m2.group(1).strip()
feature_shard12 = m2.group(2).strip()
print(f"\nUpstream shard12: {upstream_shard12[:100]}...")
print(f"Feature shard12: {feature_shard12[:100]}...")

# Merge: take feature branch shard12 AND add test-emit-design-plan-preview and test-check-plan-size after test-emit-plan
merged_shard12 = feature_shard12.replace(
    'test-emit-plan test-parse-plan-commands',
    'test-emit-plan test-emit-design-plan-preview test-check-plan-size test-parse-plan-commands'
)
content = content[:m2.start()] + merged_shard12 + '\n' + content[m2.end():]

# Re-find conflicts
matches = list(re.finditer(conflict1_pattern, content, re.DOTALL))
print(f"\nAfter conflict2 resolution: {len(matches)} remaining conflicts")

# Conflict 3: target definitions
m3 = matches[0]
upstream_targets = m3.group(1).strip()
feature_targets = m3.group(2).strip()
print(f"\nUpstream targets (first 200 chars): {upstream_targets[:200]}")
print(f"Feature targets (first 200 chars): {feature_targets[:200]}")

# Merge: include ALL targets from both sides
merged_targets = upstream_targets + '\n\n' + feature_targets
content = content[:m3.start()] + merged_targets + '\n\n' + content[m3.end():]

# Final check
remaining = re.findall(r'<<<<<<< HEAD', content)
print(f"\nRemaining conflicts: {len(remaining)}")

with open('Makefile', 'w') as f:
    f.write(content)
print("Makefile written successfully")
